title: Agricultural Adaptations to Climate Change: Private, Public, and Political Strategies in California
Land Subsidence: Science, Economics and Policy
Developing a decision support model to assess the value of cooperation benefits under climate change: Case of the Colorado River Basin in the United States
venue: Book chapter in M. Shahbazbegian & A. Dinar
abstract: Climate change exacerbates the imbalance between water demand and supply in the Colorado River basin, shared by seven US states and Mexico. As water availability decreases, current allocation rules need reconsideration since they promote inefficient water use. This chapter develops a decision support model to examine the value of cooperation in achieving efficient water use in the basin. The chapter models water uses for urban centers and irrigation districts under two different climate change scenarios. The analysis assesses the value of cooperation through water trade between sectors (agricultural and urban) and states. The Shapley value, the Nash-Harsanyi solution, and the nucleolus provide insights into the efficient share of benefits allocation under cooperative arrangements. Several stability indexes are calculated to compare the stability of the basin’s coalitional arrangements. The results highlight the relative contribution of sectors and regions to agreed water and benefits allocations. The value of cooperation increases with the severity of climate change. Cooperation enhances benefits for each state, especially for Nevada, California, Wyoming, and Utah.
abstract_zh: 气候变化加剧了科罗拉多河流域水资源需求与供给之间的失衡，该流域由美国七个州和墨西哥共享。随着可用水量减少，现行的分配规则因其助长低效用水而需要重新考虑。本章构建了一个决策支持模型，以考察在该流域实现高效用水时合作的价值。本章分别在两种不同的气候变化情景下，对城市中心和灌溉区的用水进行建模。分析评估了不同部门（农业与城市）和各州之间通过水权交易进行合作的价值。Shapley值、Nash-Harsanyi解和核仁（nucleolus）为合作安排下收益分配的效率份额提供了洞见。本章还计算了多项稳定性指数，以比较流域内各联盟安排的稳定性。结果凸显了各部门和地区在已达成的水量与收益分配中的相对贡献。合作的价值随气候变化的严重程度而增加。合作使各州收益均有所提升，其中内华达州、加利福尼亚州、怀俄明州和犹他州尤为明显。

Climate change impacts and adaptation in the agricultural sector of the Colorado River Basin: A hydro-economic analysis
venue: Book chapter in A. Dinar & R. O. Mendelsohn
abstract: In the Southwestern United States, the Colorado River Basin and its tributaries supply water to nearly 40 million people and support irrigation on approximately 2.2 million acres of agricultural land. Climate change is intensifying pressure on this system with declining inflows and increasing demands expected to strain current water allocation frameworks. This chapter employs a hydro-economic model to evaluate how the agricultural sector responds to ten climate change scenarios that combine reductions in water availability with increases in crop water requirements. The analysis shows that declining inflows and heightened irrigation demands driven by increased evapotranspiration pose significant challenges to the sustainability of existing agricultural water use. The results also point to substantial economic losses and significant regional variation in the magnitude of these impacts, underscoring the need for adaptive planning, greater economic resilience, and reforms to allocation policies to safeguard the long-term viability of the agricultural sector in the basin.
abstract_zh: 在美国西南部，科罗拉多河流域及其支流为近4000万人口供水，并支撑着约220万英亩农田的灌溉。气候变化正对这一系统施加日益增大的压力：来水减少与需求增加预计将使现行水资源分配框架面临严峻考验。本章采用水文经济模型，评估农业部门如何应对十种气候变化情景，这些情景综合了水资源可用量减少与作物需水量增加。分析表明，来水下降以及蒸散发增加所带来的灌溉需求上升，对现有农业用水的可持续性构成了重大挑战。结果还显示，经济损失规模可观，且影响在区域间差异显著，这突显了需要通过适应性规划、增强经济韧性以及改革分配政策，以保障该流域农业部门的长期可行性。

title: How Effective Are Building Codes at Reducing Residential Water Use? Evidence From California Billing Data
venue: Journal of Policy Analysis and Management
abstract: This study examines the impact of residential water‐efficiency standards on household water consumption, utilizing billing data from California. I examine both the short‐ and long‐term impacts of the California Green Building Standards Code (CALGreen), comparing homes constructed just before and after its implementation in 2010. The findings show that, on average, CALGreen homes use 11.7% less water than comparable pre‐code homes, with savings persisting over time at approximately 10.9%. Notably, engineering‐based (ex ante) estimates of water savings are nearly twice as large as the realized reductions, likely reflecting the “offsetting behavior” effect. The analysis further reveals that most water savings occur during warmer months when outdoor water use peaks. In addition, CALGreen homes exhibit lower sensitivity to temperature fluctuations, with smaller increases in use during hotter months and smaller reductions during cooler months. Finally, when accounting for compliance costs and the opportunity cost of water, the results suggest that CALGreen policy passes a cost‐effectiveness test. These findings highlight the effectiveness of building codes as a durable policy tool for achieving long‐term water conservation in fast‐growing, semi‐arid regions.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用加利福尼亚州的水账单数据，考察住宅节水标准对家庭用水量的影响。我考察了加州绿色建筑标准规范（CALGreen）的短期和长期影响，比较了其于2010年实施前后建成的住房。研究结果显示，平均而言，CALGreen住房的用水量比可比的实施前住房低11.7%，且节水效果随时间持续存在，约为10.9%。值得注意的是，基于工程方法的事前节水估计值几乎是实际减少量的两倍，这可能反映了“抵消行为”效应。分析进一步表明，大部分节水发生在室外用水高峰的温暖月份。此外，CALGreen住房对温度波动的敏感性较低：在炎热月份用水量的增幅较小，在凉爽月份用水量的降幅也较小。最后，在计入合规成本和水的机会成本后，结果表明CALGreen政策通过了成本效益检验。这些发现凸显了建筑规范作为一种持久政策工具，在快速增长的半干旱地区实现长期节水的有效性。

title: Legislative responsiveness to climate change: Politically driven adaptation in California's agricultural sector
venue: Book chapter in A. Dinar & R. O. Mendelsohn
abstract: Responses to climate change by farmers and others include private on-farm adjustments to current practices, and public programs to mitigate or adapt to its impacts. Less understood is political adaptation, whereby farmers and others lobby elected officials for policy changes. We study political adaptation by assessing legislative responsiveness to climate change. Rather than examining a few high-profile policies or searching bills for keywords, we develop a topic model to classify 44,109 bills introduced in the California State Legislature between 2001 and 2020. We provide examples of bills enhancing private adaptation, and statistical analyses that identify when lawmakers sponsor agricultural and environmental legislation. Our findings link lawmakers’ occupational experiences, constituency characteristics, and extreme weather in their districts to their bill sponsorship. In documenting legislative responsiveness to evolving conditions in the most populous and productive farm state of the US, we illuminate how individual lawmakers and political adaptation are critical to addressing climate change.
abstract_zh: 农民及其他群体应对气候变化的方式，包括对现有做法进行私人的农场调整，以及减缓或适应其影响的公共项目。而人们对政治适应的理解较少，即农民和其他群体游说民选官员推动政策变化。我们通过评估立法机构对气候变化的响应性来研究政治适应。我们并未考察少数几项备受关注的政策，也未通过关键词检索法案，而是开发了一个主题模型，对2001年至2020年间加州州议会提出的44,109项法案进行分类。我们列举了增强私人适应能力的法案实例，并通过统计分析识别立法者在何种情况下发起农业和环境立法。我们的发现将立法者的职业经历、选区特征以及其选区内的极端天气与其法案发起行为联系起来。通过记录加州（美国人口最多、农业产出最高的州）立法机构对不断变化的条件所作出的响应，我们阐明了个体立法者和政治适应对于应对气候变化的关键作用。

Adoption patterns of on-farm nutrient management practices and nitrogen application rates in California's Central Valley
abstract: Nitrogen fertilizers in irrigated agriculture improve cropland productivity, but contribute to groundwater contamination, air pollution, and greenhouse gas emissions. While California has implemented agricultural water quality regulations since the 1980s, targeted efforts to address nitrate contamination through nitrogen application reporting and management have been emphasized more recently under the Irrigated Lands Regulatory Program. This study uses a unique, field-level dataset from the Kings River Water Quality Coalition in California’s Central Valley to examine nitrogen management practices, including common combinations of practices (bundling), across crop types. The analysis draws on four years of data from Irrigation and Nutrient Management Plans and details nitrogen application and management strategies. The results show that in 80% of fields across crops, between 50 and 300 pounds per acre (lbs/acre) of nitrogen is applied. Crop-level nitrogen applied minus nitrogen removed (A-R) values show substantial variation, with walnuts showing a nitrogen surplus (+65.5 lbs/acre) and alfalfa a significant deficit (−424.5 lbs/acre). Many growers adopt multiple practices, with 26% of fields utilizing six practices and 24% using five. Such bundling may provide growers with more flexibility in managing nitrogen applications. Further research is needed to evaluate the effect of various nitrogen management practices on fertilizer use and water quality effects.
abstract_zh: 灌溉农业中使用的氮肥可提高耕地生产力，但也会造成地下水污染、空气污染和温室气体排放。尽管加州自20世纪80年代起就实施了农业水质监管，但近年来，在灌溉土地管理计划（Irrigated Lands Regulatory Program）之下，通过氮肥施用报告与管理来应对硝酸盐污染的针对性措施受到了更多重视。本研究利用来自加州中央谷地金斯河水质联盟（Kings River Water Quality Coalition）的一套独特的田块级数据集，考察各作物类型的氮素管理做法，包括常见的做法组合（捆绑式采用）。分析基于灌溉与养分管理计划四年的数据，详细记录了氮肥施用与管理策略。结果显示，在各类作物的80%田块中，每英亩施用氮肥50至300磅。按作物计算的施氮量减去氮素移出量（A-R）数值差异显著：核桃呈现氮盈余（+65.5磅/英亩），而苜蓿则出现显著的氮亏缺（−424.5磅/英亩）。许多种植者同时采用多种做法，其中26%的田块采用六种做法，24%采用五种做法。此类捆绑式采用可能使种植者在管理氮肥施用方面拥有更大灵活性。仍需进一步研究，以评估各类氮素管理做法对化肥使用及水质的影响。

title: Assessing the economic value of water in the Colorado River Basin: A hydroeconomic analysis

High-frequency analytics and residential water consumption: Estimating heterogeneous effects
abstract: This paper estimates how high-frequency online Home Water Use Reports (HWURs) affect household-level water consumption. The HWURs under the study share social comparisons, consumption analytics, leak alerts, and conservation information to residential accounts, primarily through digital communications. The data utilized in this paper is a daily panel dataset that tracks single-family residential households from January 2013 to September 2019. We found a 6.2 % reduction in average daily household water consumption for a typical household enrolled in the program. We estimate heterogeneous treatment effects by the day of the week, the content of push notifications, and baseline consumption quintile. For the latter, we provide an illustrative test to emphasize how mean reversion can severely bias a naïve panel data estimator for heterogeneous treatment effects when the source of heterogeneity is the outcome variable. We also find evidence that leak alerts effectively reduce water consumption immediately following the alert. • High-frequency online Home Water Use Reports (HWURs) lead to a 6.2 % reduction in water consumption for a typical household enrolled in the program. • We estimate significant heterogeneity in the treatment effects depending on the day of the week, the content of push notifications, and the baseline consumption levels. • Our analysis indicates that leak alerts are particularly effective at reducing water consumption immediately after they are issued • We illustrate how mean reversion can bias a naïve panel estimator for heterogeneous treatment effects when heterogeneity arises from the outcome variable.
abstract_zh: 本文估计高频在线家庭用水报告（HWURs）如何影响家庭用水量。本研究中的HWURs主要通过数字通信向住宅用户发送社会比较、用水分析、漏水警报和节水信息。本文所用数据是一个日度面板数据集，追踪了2013年1月至2019年9月的独户住宅家庭。我们发现，对于一个典型的参与该项目的家庭，其日均用水量下降了6.2%。我们按星期几、推送通知的内容以及基线用水量五分位数估计异质性处理效应。针对最后一项，我们提供了一个示例性检验，以说明当异质性来源于结果变量本身时，均值回归如何会严重扭曲朴素的面板数据估计量对异质性处理效应的估计。我们还发现，漏水警报在发出后会立即有效减少用水量。• 高频在线家庭用水报告（HWURs）可使参与项目的典型家庭用水量减少6.2%。• 处理效应在星期几、推送通知内容以及基线用水水平方面存在显著异质性。• 我们的分析表明，漏水警报在发出后立即减少用水量的效果尤为显著。• 我们说明，当异质性源于结果变量时，均值回归可能使朴素面板估计量对异质性处理效应的估计产生偏误。

title: Microplastic exposure disparities in California communities through bottled water consumption
abstract: Increasingly, governmental agencies are taking action in response to health concerns associated with microplastic exposure in drinking water. These efforts have focused primarily on municipal tap water rather than bottled water. This is concerning, given the surge in bottled water consumption in the U.S., a surge partially fueled by negative perceptions of tap water quality, especially among minority communities. Even though microplastics may not be the biggest health risk or primary reason for consumer choices around tap and bottled water, the rising concerns around microplastic exposure and impacts on human health are important to take into consideration. A systematic review was conducted to assess microplastic concentrations in various sources of drinking water, including bottled water and municipal tap water. To facilitate a more accurate comparison of microplastic concentrations between studies, we realigned the analyzed microplastic size classes between studies. Additionally, trends in California household-level bottled water purchases were analyzed using a nationwide dataset of bottled water transactions to determine the corresponding rates of microplastic exposure associated with these consumption patterns. Our results suggest that there is a sevenfold higher concentration of microplastics in bottled water compared to tap water globally. In comparison, studies conducted in the Global North have found a six times higher concentration of microplastics in bottled water compared to tap water, and seven times more microplastics in bottled water compared to tap water in the Global South. While income is found to be positively associated with bottled water purchases and increases in microplastic exposure in California, substantial disparities in exposure persist by ethnicity and race after controlling for income. Although microplastics may not be the primary health risk or the primary reason for consumer choices regarding tap and bottled water, the growing concerns about microplastic exposure and its impacts on human health are important to consider. Choices made by consumers regarding drinking water types, regardless of the reason for these choices, should be made with the best available information. Therefore, our results underscore the importance of addressing information disparities related to bottled water quality. This is particularly important within marginalized communities served by high-quality municipal drinking water, where misperceptions of tap water quality and limited information on bottled water quality contribute to the consumption of bottled water.
abstract_zh: 政府机构日益针对饮用水中微塑料暴露所引发的健康担忧采取行动。这些努力主要集中于市政自来水，而非瓶装水。鉴于美国瓶装水消费激增，而这一激增部分源于对自来水水质的负面看法（在少数族裔社区尤为明显），这一状况令人担忧。尽管微塑料可能并非最大的健康风险，也不是消费者在自来水与瓶装水之间做出选择的主要原因，但人们对微塑料暴露及其对人体健康影响的日益关注，仍然值得重视。我们开展了一项系统综述，以评估包括瓶装水和市政自来水在内的各类饮用水来源中的微塑料浓度。为便于更准确地比较不同研究之间的微塑料浓度，我们对各研究中分析的微塑料粒径类别进行了重新归并。此外，我们利用全国瓶装水交易数据集，分析了加利福尼亚州家庭层面瓶装水购买的趋势，以确定与这些消费模式相对应的微塑料暴露率。我们的结果表明，全球范围内，瓶装水中的微塑料浓度是自来水的七倍。相比之下，北半球（Global North）的研究发现瓶装水中的微塑料浓度是自来水的六倍，而南半球（Global South）的研究发现瓶装水中的微塑料数量则是自来水的七倍。尽管在加利福尼亚州，收入与瓶装水购买及微塑料暴露的增加呈正相关，但在控制收入之后，不同族裔和种族之间的暴露差异依然显著。尽管微塑料可能并非主要健康风险，也不是消费者在自来水与瓶装水之间做出选择的主要原因，但人们对微塑料暴露及其对人体健康影响日益增长的担忧，仍然值得重视。无论出于何种原因，消费者对饮用水类型的选择都应基于现有的最佳信息做出。因此，我们的结果强调，解决与瓶装水水质相关的信息不对称问题至关重要。这一点对于那些享有高质量市政饮用水、但社区长期处于边缘地位的群体尤为重要：在这些社区，对自来水水质的误解以及有关瓶装水水质的信息匮乏，助长了瓶装水的消费。

title: Public Spending and Water Scarcity: An Empirical Analysis of USBR Investments in the Colorado River Basin
venue: Journal of the American Water Resources Association
abstract: Rigid historical agreements, rapid population growth, and the accelerating impacts of climate change have significantly increased the complexity of water management and importance of water in the Colorado River Basin, leading to persistent and at times severe water supply shortages. Various policy interventions aim to address this challenge, with federal government funding for supply and demand management being a key component, as seen in initiatives such as compensated conservation programs. Utilizing data from the US Bureau of Reclamation, a primary source of funding for the basin water efficiency and management, we analyze the distribution of these funds, ex‐ante estimated water savings, and estimate the cost of water saved. Our analysis covers 462 projects across 10 programs from 2004 to 2024, spanning over 200 locations across the seven states that share the Basin water. The total funding for these efficiency programs amounts to approximately $1.08 billion (2023 constant dollars). Our analysis indicates that approximately 81% of the funds are allocated to projects aimed at reducing water demand, and about 19% are allocated to projects that augment water supply. In terms of geographic distribution, 5.7% of funds went to the Upper Basin states, 75.5% to the Lower Basin states, and 18.8% to Tribal areas. Across all projects, the estimated cost of water saved ranged widely, from approximately $385 to $2444 per acre‐foot saved.
abstract_zh: 僵化的历史协议、快速的人口增长以及气候变化日益加剧的影响，显著提高了科罗拉多河流域水资源管理的复杂性，凸显了水资源的重要性，并导致持续且有时严重的供水短缺。多项政策干预旨在应对这一挑战，其中联邦政府对供给与需求管理的资助是关键组成部分，例如补偿性节水计划等举措。本文利用美国垦务局（US Bureau of Reclamation）的数据——该机构是流域节水与管理的主要资金来源——分析这些资金的分配情况、事前估计的节水量，并估算所节约水量的成本。我们的分析涵盖2004年至2024年间10个项目中的462个子项目，分布于共享流域水资源的七个州的200多个地点。这些节水项目的资金总额约为10.8亿美元（按2023年不变美元计算）。分析表明，约81%的资金分配给旨在减少水需求的项目，约19%分配给旨在增加水供给的项目。从地理分布看，5.7%的资金流向上游流域各州，75.5%流向下游流域各州，18.8%流向部落地区。在所有项目中，所估计的节水成本差异很大，每单位节水量（英亩-英尺）的成本从约385美元到2444美元不等。

title: Advancements to the Ricardian model in the past quarter to century
Residential irrigation restrictions and water conservation: A review of studies from 1978 to 2022
venue: Journal of Contemporary Water Research & Education
abstract: Urban water managers and policymakers have adopted demand management strategies to reduce water use and buffer against short‐term water supply shortfalls. This article provides a systematic review of publications from 1978‐2022 that examine the effectiveness of residential water use restrictions as the primary demand‐side management tool. Our results indicate the significant overall effect of restrictions on reducing water consumption, with an average reduction of 12.3% from the 23 studies reviewed in this article. When evaluating effect strength by restriction type (mandatory versus voluntary), voluntary restrictions have a significantly lower effect than mandatory restrictions on water use. We also find an inverse correlation between the number of irrigation days allowed and the estimated effect strength.
abstract_zh: 城市水资源管理者和政策制定者已采取需求管理策略，以减少用水量并缓冲短期供水不足。本文对1978年至2022年间考察住宅用水限制作为主要需求侧管理工具之效果的文献进行了系统综述。结果表明，用水限制对减少用水量具有显著的总体效果：本文综述的23项研究显示平均减少12.3%。按限制类型（强制性与自愿性）评估效果强度时，自愿性限制对用水量的影响显著低于强制性限制。我们还发现，允许的灌溉天数与估计的效果强度之间存在负相关。

title: The impact of pricing structure change on residential water demand: A long-term analysis of water utilities in California
abstract: California's demand-side urban water management policies, such as shifting water pricing structures from non-conservation to conservation-based rates, have received much attention in terms of meeting the state's short- and long-term water conservation policies. This paper quantifies the effect of pricing structure changes on residential water consumption using a survey dataset of 189 major California water utilities from 1994 to 2019. Results of our study demonstrate that residential per capita per day water consumption was reduced by an average of 2.6% when water agencies switched from non-conservation-based to conservation-based pricing structures. We also found evidence that the longer a utility maintained a non-conservation-based rate structure before switching to conservation-based pricing, the larger the water consumption reduction in that utility's service area. In addition, utilities that reverted to non-conservation rates after having longer-term conservation pricing structures experienced smaller increases compared to having long-term non-conservation ones in water use in their service areas. This suggests evidence of a crowding-in effect for transitions from conservation-based to non-conservation-based pricing structures.
abstract_zh: 加州的需求侧城市水资源管理政策，例如将水价结构从非节约型费率转变为节约型费率，在实现该州短期和长期节水政策目标方面受到广泛关注。本文利用1994年至2019年间加州189家主要水务公司的调查数据，量化了水价结构变化对住宅用水量的影响。研究结果表明，当供水机构从非节约型定价转为节约型定价时，住宅人均日用水量平均减少了2.6%。我们还发现证据表明，供水机构在转向节约型定价之前维持非节约型费率结构的时间越长，该公司服务区域内的用水量减少幅度就越大。此外，在长期实行节约型定价之后又恢复非节约型费率的公用事业，其服务区域内用水量的增幅，相较于长期维持非节约型费率的情况更小。这表明，从节约型定价转向非节约型定价的过渡存在“挤入”效应。

title: Water markets in California: Punching below its weight
venue: Book chapter in Encyclopedia of water policy and economics. Edward Elgar Publishing

title: Does farm size matter for participating in a land-fallowing policy? Evidence from China
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: Land fallowing policy reduces the negative resource-use externalities, including water resources. Previous studies of land fallowing policies identified different factors that explain the willingness of farmers to participate in these programmes. However, less attention was placed on farm size as an important explanatory variable. We develop a theoretical model to explain the role of farm size in decisions to participate in land fallowing programmes. We then apply the theory to the Seasonal Land Fallowing Policy (SLFP), enacted to reduce agricultural groundwater use by fallowing the cultivated land of winter wheat in Hebei Province, China. Both small- and large-scale farmers participate in the programme. Using survey data, we examined whether farm size matters in decisions to participate as part of a set of variables, including farm and farmer characteristics and government requirements. Our results indicate that farm size significantly affects participation in the programme— the larger the farm, the more likely it will participate. The results are robust to various specifications. We also find that government requirements largely impact the decisions of small-scale farmers to participate. The findings have important implications for policy formulation and distinction among small- and large- scale farms.
abstract_zh: 休耕政策减少了包括水资源在内的负面资源利用外部性。以往对休耕政策的研究识别了解释农民参与意愿的不同因素，但较少关注农场规模这一重要解释变量。我们建立了一个理论模型，以解释农场规模在农民是否参与休耕计划的决策中所起的作用。随后，我们将该理论应用于季节性休耕政策（SLFP）。该政策旨在通过在河北省休耕冬小麦耕地，以减少农业地下水的使用。无论小规模还是大规模农户均参与了该计划。利用调查数据，我们考察了农场规模是否在一组变量（包括农场和农户特征以及政府要求）中对参与决策具有影响。结果表明，农场规模显著影响参与计划的决定：农场规模越大，参与的可能性越高。结果在多种设定下均保持稳健。我们还发现，政府要求在很大程度上影响小规模农户的参与决策。这些发现对政策制定以及区分小规模和大规模农场具有重要启示。

title: Residential water conservation and the rebound effect: A temporal decomposition and investigation
abstract: Water conservation in California has been a major subject of concern for agencies in their efforts to satisfy their residential demand while coping with frequent shortfalls, especially in periods of drought. During the 2012–2016 severe drought in California, the state enacted a conservation mandate that imposed specific conservation targets of 4% up to 36% for water utilities. While the utilities met those targets in 2015, water use, on average, has slowly crept up or rebounded subsequently, although not to pre‐drought levels. Understanding the manner and degree to which water use rebounds can be critically important for water utilities in their planning and investment decisions. Using a unique panel dataset on single‐family residential water use by nearly 20,000 customers of a Northern California water agency from 2013 to 2019, this paper explores the magnitude and character of the rebound effect that occurred after the cessation of a statewide conservation mandate that was imposed on water use in response a severe drought enveloping California from 2014 through 2016. Our results suggest the presence of a significant rebound in water use—of approximately 9% on average—after the conservation mandate ended. Yet, and novel to our research, we find significant heterogeneity in the rebound effects across seasons and water users, with a greater rebound in the warm season months relative to other months and among lower water use households relative to higher water use households. Our results also suggest a significant shift in water use to earlier periods of the day once the mandate was lifted. Understanding the magnitude and variation in rebound effects both temporally and across different types of water users can be useful to water agencies in their efforts to make informed decisions surrounding investments, management, and messaging in response to drought, conservation, and water scarcity.
abstract_zh: 在加利福尼亚州，节约用水一直是各机构关注的重大问题，它们既要满足居民用水需求，又要应对频繁出现的供水短缺，尤其是干旱时期。在2012至2016年加州严重干旱期间，该州颁布了节水强制令，要求供水公司实现4%至36%不等的具体节水目标。尽管供水公司在2015年达到了这些目标，但此后用水量平均而言缓慢回升，尽管尚未恢复到干旱前的水平。了解用水回升的方式与程度，对供水公司的规划和投资决策至关重要。本文利用一个独特的面板数据集，该数据集涵盖北加州某供水机构近20,000名客户2013年至2019年的单户住宅用水情况，考察了2014至2016年间加州严重干旱期间实施的全州性节水强制令于解除后所出现的反弹效应的幅度与特征。我们的结果表明，节水强制令结束后，用水量出现了显著反弹，平均约为9%。与以往研究不同的是，我们还发现反弹效应在季节和用水者之间存在显著异质性：暖季月份的反弹幅度大于其他月份，低用水量家庭的反弹幅度大于高用水量家庭。我们的结果还表明，强制令解除后，用水显著转移到了一天中更早的时段。理解反弹效应在时间上以及不同类型用水者之间的幅度与差异，有助于供水机构围绕投资、管理和宣传作出明智决策，以应对干旱、节水和水资源短缺问题。

title: Application of distributed ledger platforms in smart water systems--A literature review
Assessing the Vulnerability of California water utilities to wildfires
abstract: Wildfires are becoming more frequent and destructive in California, and it is essential to quantify their potential impacts on drinking water utilities. This study aims to measure the severity of wildfires in each California water utility based on the exposure frequency and the extent of area burned by wildfires in each service area. Our quantitative models show an association between water utility characteristics and their vulnerability to wildfires. Findings indicate that wildfire vulnerability is higher in government-owned utilities than private ones, utilities primarily relying on surface water than groundwater, and utilities using local-sourced water than purchased water. Also, we find a stronger association between wildfire vulnerability and large utilities in terms of population served than small or medium ones. Regarding geography, we find wildfire vulnerability is higher in southern and coastal California utilities than in Northern and inland California. These results help water utilities and land managers identify vulnerable locations and develop wildfire management and disaster preparedness strategies.
abstract_zh: 加州的野火日趋频繁且破坏性增强，因此量化其对饮用水公用事业的潜在影响至关重要。本研究旨在根据各服务区内野火的暴露频率和过火面积，衡量加州每家水务公司所遭受的野火严重程度。我们的定量模型显示，水务公司特征与其野火脆弱性之间存在关联。研究发现，政府所有的水务公司比私营公司更易受野火影响；主要依赖地表水而非地下水的公司更易受影响；使用本地水源而非外购水的公司更易受影响。此外，就服务人口而言，大型水务公司与野火脆弱性之间的关联比中小型公司更强。在地理上，加州南部和沿海地区的水务公司比北部和内陆地区的野火脆弱性更高。这些结果有助于水务公司和土地管理者识别脆弱地点，并制定野火管理和灾害防备策略。

title: Historical trends of residential water use in California: Effects of droughts and conservation policies
abstract: Conservation efforts to reduce residential water use have a long history in California. This article examines residential water use changes, measured by gallons per capita per day (GPCD), using a comprehensive monthly panel dataset of California's public water agencies during 1994–2019. We find that, on average, GPCD was reduced by 34% in 2019 when compared to 1994 levels. Controlling for the region, water source, and water agency characteristics suggest significant differences in policy performance. The differential effectiveness of conservation policies indicates a need to consider policy differentiation based on the agencies' objective and subjective conditions.
abstract_zh: 减少住宅用水的节约努力在加州有着悠久的历史。本文利用加州公共供水机构1994年至2019年的综合月度面板数据集，考察以每人每日加仑数（GPCD）衡量的住宅用水变化。我们发现，与1994年水平相比，2019年人均日用水量平均下降了34%。在控制地区、水源及供水机构特征后，结果表明政策成效存在显著差异。节约政策效果的差异表明，有必要根据各机构的客观和主观条件考虑差异化的政策设计。

title: Re-examining water affordability: A comparison of alternative measures
venue: Journal of the American Water Resources Association

title: The impact of COVID-19 on urban water consumption in the United States
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has changed how we define “home”, which is recast as the new coffee shop, restaurant, entertainment center, and office during the pandemic. The shift toward working from home led to substantial changes in how consumers behave, affecting the consumption of resources in some cases for years to come. Using data from six water utilities in various states in the U.S., we investigated how water consumption has changed attributable to the implementation of stay-at-home (SAH) orders. The results indicated an overall increase of between 3.08% and 13.65% in daily water consumption during the SAH orders compared to the same period in 2018 and 2019, with the gaps closing as lockdown restrictions eased. The findings also revealed that the changes in water consumption across sectors and user groups were heterogeneous. Specifically, the results showed that total daily residential water demand during SAH orders in 2020 increased significantly, between 11.80% and 13.65%, relative to the same period in 2018 and 2019, but the changes in water consumption for non-residential properties headed in opposite directions with reductions between −22.53% and −45.08%. In addition, we found that the low-income groups did not change their water consumption even with the lockdown.
abstract_zh: 新冠疫情改变了我们对“家”的定义，疫情期间，家庭被重新定义为新的咖啡馆、餐厅、娱乐中心和办公室。居家办公的转变导致消费者行为发生了重大变化，在某些情况下，这种影响可能持续数年，并影响资源消费。利用美国多个州六家水务公司的数据，我们考察了居家令（SAH）的实施导致用水量发生了怎样的变化。结果显示，与2018年和2019年同期相比，居家令期间日均用水量总体增加了3.08%至13.65%，且随着封锁限制的放宽，差距逐渐缩小。研究还发现，各部门和各用户群体的用水变化存在异质性。具体而言，结果显示，2020年居家令期间的住宅日总用水需求，相较于2018年和2019年同期显著增加了11.80%至13.65%；而非住宅用地的用水量变化方向相反，减少幅度为22.53%至45.08%。此外，我们发现，即使在封锁期间，低收入群体的用水量也没有变化。

title: Consumer welfare consequences of the California drought conservation mandate
abstract: We measure consumer welfare losses from reductions in water use following California's conservation mandate in 2015, which imposed utility service area‐specific conservation targets of 4% up to 36%. We document imperfect compliance with the mandate and discuss factors that may explain the pattern of reductions ultimately observed. The basis for calculating welfare losses is an econometric model of residential water demand that yields local demands with elasticities ranging from −0.56 to −0.10. In terms of economic efficiency, we estimate a 20% gain in consumer welfare under the efficient allocation of conservation reductions relative to the observed pattern of reductions.
abstract_zh: 我们衡量了加州2015年节水强制令实施后，用水减少所带来的消费者福利损失。该强制令为各供水服务区设定了4%至36%不等的节水目标。我们记录了对该强制令的不完全遵守情况，并讨论了可能解释最终观察到的减水模式的因素。福利损失的计算基于一个住宅用水需求的计量经济模型，该模型得出的本地需求弹性范围为−0.56至−0.10。在经济效率方面，我们估计，相对于观察到的减水模式，若将节水减量按有效配置分配，消费者福利可提高20%。

title: Recovering forecast distributions of crop composition: Method and application to Kentucky agriculture
abstract: This paper proposes a novel application of the multinomial logit (MNL) model using Cropland Data Layer and field-level boundaries to estimate crop transition probabilities, which are used to generate forecast distributions of total acreage for five major crops produced in the state of Kentucky. These forecasts distributions have a wide range of applications that, besides providing interim acreage estimates ahead of the June Acreage Survey, can inform the ability of producers to incorporate new crops in the land-use rotation, investments in location-specific capital and input distribution as well informing the likelihood of adverse water quality events from nutrient run-off.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种多项Logit（MNL）模型的新应用，利用耕地数据层（Cropland Data Layer）和田块级边界数据来估计作物转换概率，并以此生成肯塔基州五种主要作物总播种面积的预测分布。这些预测分布具有广泛的应用价值：除了能在六月播种面积调查（June Acreage Survey）之前提供阶段性面积估计外，还可帮助生产者判断是否将新作物纳入轮作体系，为基于地点的资本和投入品配置投资提供参考，并有助于判断养分径流导致不良水质事件的可能性。

title: The impact of information-based interventions on conservation behavior: A meta-analysis
abstract: Interest in using information-based interventions to induce energy and water conservation has increased in recent years but have shown mixed evidence of their effectiveness. This paper seeks to answer two main questions - whether these programs are broadly effective in inducing conservation, and what are the most effective versions of these programs. Using a meta-analysis of 116 studies, we examine the effects of information-based interventions on residential customers' consumption of electricity, gas, and water. We find evidence of publication bias in this literature. After correcting for publication bias, meta-analysis results indicate that information-based interventions reduce consumption by an average of 6.24%, 95% CI [-10.72, -1.76]. In addition, we find that studies employing RCTs find smaller conservation effects, (-5.2%, 95% CI [−9.53, −0.51]). Our results show that the effectiveness of information-based interventions at the household level are significantly larger than those at the aggregate level (such as dorms and buildings). Finally, interventions with a shorter duration or with more frequent reporting show larger estimated effect sizes.
abstract_zh: 近年来，利用信息型干预措施促进能源和水资源节约的兴趣日益增长，但其有效性的证据并不一致。本文试图回答两个主要问题：这些项目是否普遍有效地促进节约，以及这些项目的哪些版本最为有效。我们对116项研究进行了元分析，考察信息型干预措施对住宅用户电力、天然气和水的消费的影响。我们发现该文献存在发表偏倚的证据。在校正发表偏倚后，元分析结果显示，信息型干预措施平均使消费减少6.24%，95%置信区间为[-10.72, -1.76]。此外，我们发现采用随机对照试验（RCT）的研究所估计的节约效果较小（-5.2%，95%置信区间为[−9.53, −0.51]）。我们的结果表明，信息型干预在家庭层面的有效性显著高于集体层面（如宿舍和楼宇）。最后，持续时间较短或报告频率较高的干预，估计的效应规模更大。

title: Unintended consequences of water conservation on the use of treated municipal wastewater
Water markets in the western United States: Trends and opportunities
abstract: Efforts to address water scarcity have traditionally relied on changing the spatial and temporal availability of water through water importation, storage, and conveyance. More recently, water managers have invested heavily in improving water use efficiency and conservation. Yet as new supply options become harder to find and/or appropriate, and demand hardens, society must consider other options to, if not reduce scarcity, minimize the impacts of such scarcity. This paper explores the role water markets are playing in addressing water scarcity in the American southwest: a water-limited arid and semi-arid region characterized by significant population growth rates relative to the rest of the US. Focusing on three representative southwestern states—Arizona, California, and Texas—we begin by highlighting how trends in water supply allocations from different water sources (e.g., surface water, groundwater, and wastewater) and water demand by different water users (e.g., agricultural, municipal, and environmental) have changed over time within each state. We then present recent data that shows how water trading has changed over time—in terms of value and volume—both at state level and sector level aggregates. We end with a discussion regarding some institutional adjustments that are necessary for water markets to achieve their potential in helping society address water scarcity.
abstract_zh: 解决水资源短缺问题，传统上依赖于通过调水、蓄水和输水来改变水的时空可得性。近来，水资源管理者大量投资于提高用水效率和节约用水。然而，随着新的供水选择越来越难以找到和/或获取，而需求又日益刚性，社会必须考虑其他选择，即便无法减少短缺，也要尽量减轻此类短缺的影响。本文探讨水市场在解决美国西南部水资源短缺问题中所发挥的作用。美国西南部是一个水资源有限的干旱和半干旱地区，其人口增长速度显著高于美国其他地区。我们以亚利桑那州、加利福尼亚州和得克萨斯州这三个具有代表性的西南部州为研究对象，首先重点分析了各州内不同水源（例如地表水、地下水和废水）的供水分配趋势，以及不同用水者（例如农业、市政和环境用水）的需求随时间的变化。随后，我们展示了近期数据，反映了水交易在价值和交易量方面随时间的变化，包括州和部门两个层面的汇总情况。最后，我们讨论了水市场要充分发挥作用、帮助社会应对水资源短缺所需要的一些制度调整。

title: Are free trade agreements good for the environment? A panel data analysis
abstract:
This study empirically examines the relationship between free trade agreements (
FTA
s) and greenhouse gas (
GHG
) emissions. For this purpose, we use three different
FTA
s: the Southern Common Market, the North American Free Trade Agreement, and the Australia–United States Free Trade Agreement. These
FTA
s are between developing, both developing and developed, and only developed countries, respectively. Panel unit root, panel cointegration, and fully modified ordinary least squares estimations are employed to examine the long‐run relationship between
GHG
emissions and trade liberalization. The results indicate that the environmental effects of
FTA
s depend on the different agreement types. When
FTA
s are between only developed or developing countries, overall there is no environmental damage, and these types of
FTA
s can be beneficial for the environmental quality in the long run. However, when developing and developed countries are in a trade agreement, overall environmental quality decreases due to increased
GHG
emissions.
abstract_zh: 本研究实证考察了自由贸易协定（FTAs）与温室气体（GHG）排放之间的关系。为此，我们使用了三个不同的自由贸易协定：南方共同市场、北美自由贸易协定以及澳大利亚—美国自由贸易协定。这些自由贸易协定分别发生在发展中国家之间、发展中国家与发达国家之间，以及仅发达国家之间。我们采用面板单位根检验、面板协整检验以及完全修正的普通最小二乘法（FMOLS）估计，考察温室气体排放与贸易自由化之间的长期关系。结果表明，自由贸易协定的环境效应取决于协定类型。当自由贸易协定仅发生在发达国家或发展中国家之间时，总体上不会造成环境损害，这类协定从长期看可能有利于环境质量。然而，当发展中国家与发达国家处于同一贸易协定中时，由于温室气体排放增加，环境质量总体下降。

title: The ISO-14001 standard and firms' environmental performance: evidence from the U.S. transportation equipment manufacturers
venue: Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics

title: A systematic review of consumer preference for ecigarette attributes: Flavor, nicotine strength, and type
Asymmetric price volatility transmission between U.S. biofuel, corn, and oil markets
venue: Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
abstract: Linkages between agricultural commodity and energy prices have become more complex with increased ethanol production. The concern is whether the new corn–ethanol links lead to volatility spillover transmission between food and energy prices. We investigate asymmetric volatility spillovers between oil, corn, and ethanol prices using a BEKK-multivariate-GARCH approach. Additionally, we use daily, weekly, and monthly futures prices to examine whether the use of different-frequency data leads to inconsistent results. The results support the existence of asymmetric volatility transmission between corn and ethanol prices. Furthermore, the volatility spillover effects are different for the different-frequency prices, and positive and negative price changes generate inconsistent results.
abstract_zh: 随着乙醇产量的增加，农产品与能源价格之间的联系变得更加复杂。问题在于，新的玉米—乙醇联系是否会导致食品与能源价格之间的波动溢出传导。我们使用BEKK多元GARCH方法，考察石油、玉米和乙醇价格之间的非对称波动溢出。此外，我们使用日度、周度和月度期货价格，检验不同频率的数据是否会导致结果不一致。结果支持玉米与乙醇价格之间存在非对称波动传导。此外，不同频率价格的波动溢出效应存在差异，而且价格的正向与负向变动所产生的结果并不一致。

title: Dynamics of price adjustment in qualitatively differentiated U.S. markets: The case of organic and non-organic apples
